name: Apartment Love Triangle
source:
Welcome to your new apartment—a couples-only paradise! Dive into the vibrant chaos of city life, a new job, and a thrilling love triangle. With four handsome bachelors at your fingertips, your adventure is just beginning. Will you find true love amid the drama, or will your heart be torn between passion and loyalty?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.apartmentotome]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到你的新公寓——情侣专用的天堂！深入充满活力的混乱城市​​生活、一份新工作和一段惊心动魄的三角恋。四位英俊的单身汉触手可及，你的冒险才刚刚开始。你会在戏剧中找到真爱，还是会在激情和忠诚之间撕裂？

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.apartmentotome]Google Play[/url]]
